draft.title: Short-term and long-term objectives
card: Set for a year or less. They are tactical and operational: they deal with the day-to-day running of the business.
Set for several years. They are strategic: they set the main direction of the whole business.
Short-term objectives are often steps towards a long-term one. A business may aim to cut costs by 5% this year as one step towards a larger goal for the next five years.
A business can measure its progress on a long-term objective by checking whether it has met its short-term ones along the way.
draft.remember: Short-term objectives are set for a year or less and run the business now. Long-term objectives are set for several years and steer its direction.

a.q: Which objective is a short-term, operational objective for a business?
opts: Collect all overdue customer payments this quarter
Double the number of stores nationally within six years
Become the largest supplier in the region within eight years
Build a national brand that is trusted over the next decade
a.why: Collecting overdue payments this quarter is set for under a year and deals with daily running of the business. The others look several years ahead and set direction, so they are long-term. Doubling the stores is tempting because it has a number, but a number does not make it short-term.
a.clue: Look at the time frame and whether it deals with daily running.

b.q: Priya owns a bakery chain in Newcastle. She wants to open ten new bakeries in five years. Which objective is a short-term step towards this?
opts: Save enough profit this year to fund the first new bakery
Open the tenth bakery in the fifth year
Be the best known bakery brand in the state in five years
Open bakeries in three more regional towns over four years
b.why: Saving profit this year is set for a year or less and is a step towards the long-term goal. The other three each run for several years, so they are long-term, even though they also support the plan. The opening of the tenth bakery is tempting because it is a clear target, but it is set for five years.
b.clue: Which one fits inside a single year?

a.best: Collect all overdue customer payments this quarter

b.best: Save enough profit this year to fund the first new bakery

problems.detail: The clue 'Which one fits inside a single year?' could lead a student to 'Open the tenth bakery in the fifth year', since that event also happens within one year. A better clue would be 'Which one is set for this year?'
